# Bullish Signs Continue - The Friday Market Wrap!

First listed: 2025-06-27 | Evaluation cutoff: 2026-11-10

[Back to library](../README.md)

## Source versions

- [YouTube: Bullish Signs Continue - The Friday Market Wrap!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50) - 2025-06-27
- [Substack: Bullish Signs Continue - The Friday Market Wrap!](https://realeismanplaybook.substack.com/p/bullish-signs-continue-the-friday-c3c) - 2025-06-28

Earliest listed publication among matched versions, not proof of an unedited contemporaneous archive. Claim timestamps refer to the reviewed version.

## Summary

Eisman interprets the market rebound as evidence that trade-war fears have receded. He remains structurally bullish on US technology, discusses cruise and Nike results, and explains why incumbent payment networks may absorb stablecoins. He forecasts a Mamdani mayoral victory after the primary.

The payment-network integration thesis is stronger than his simplified account of stablecoin reserves and competition. Fiserv explicitly partnered with Circle, and Tether did not hold only Treasuries. The mayoral prediction was correct; that is a political forecast, not investment performance.

## Material claims

<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c001"></a>
### 001. The market rebound reflects a conclusion that the trade scare is unlikely to produce recession.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 1:19-2:55](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=79s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Prices and recession expectations moved together, but that does not isolate causality or establish what all investors believed.

Assessment test: Compare dated recession probabilities, earnings expectations and event returns.


<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c002"></a>
### 002. Nvidia growth demonstrates that AI infrastructure demand remains exceptionally strong.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 2:57-3:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=177s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The first-quarter release reported 69% revenue growth. This supports current demand, not a measurable claim that the industry is still in its infancy.

Assessment test: Track revenue, orders, customer funding and realized returns.

- [Nvidia fiscal Q1 2026 results](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2026) (2025-05-28): Revenue reached $44.1 billion, growing 69% year over year. The release also describes a substantial H20 export-restriction charge.

<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c003"></a>
### 003. The US is structurally attractive because of technology dynamism, with trade war the main threat.

**Not testable** | Steve Eisman | investment thesis | major

[Source at 3:26-4:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=206s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The long-term investment view has no benchmark, horizon or valuation entry rule. Trade war is not specified as an exhaustive formal risk model.

Assessment test: Define benchmark-relative returns and alternative downside risks.

### 004. The short Israel-Iran conflict and ceasefire reduced the immediate oil risk premium.

<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c005"></a>
### 005. Carnival results and raised guidance show resilient cruise demand and earnings.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 5:26-6:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=326s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The company raised its adjusted earnings outlook to about 40% growth. This verifies a contemporaneous operating diagnosis, not a new forecast.

<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c008"></a>
### 008. Zohran Mamdani will probably win the November mayoral election.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | forecast | major

[Source at 7:08-7:33](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=428s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: November 2025

<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c009"></a>
### 009. Stablecoins are economically different from unbacked speculative tokens because reserves support redemption.

**Mixed** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 8:14-9:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=494s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The distinction is useful, but stablecoins remain cryptoassets and backing quality, redemption access and operational risks vary. Tether reserves include assets beyond Treasuries.

Assessment test: Inspect issuer reserve composition, legal claims and redemption arrangements.

- [Tether first-quarter 2025 reserve statement](https://tether.io/news/tether-approaching-120b-in-u-s-treasuries-confirms-quarterly-operating-profit-over-1b-and-strengthens-global-usdt-demand-in-q1-2025/) (2025-05-01): The issuer disclosed gold and crypto exposure alongside Treasury exposure before the episode. Reserve assets were not exclusively short-term Treasuries.

<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c010"></a>
### 010. Circle and Tether invest customers money in short-term Treasuries, so the money is safe.

**Wrong** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 8:27-9:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=507s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Tether already disclosed gold and crypto exposure. Even Treasury-backed issuance is not an unconditional guarantee of secondary-market parity or unrestricted redemption.

Assessment test: Match reserve assets, custody and liabilities rather than infer safety from the label.

- [Tether first-quarter 2025 reserve statement](https://tether.io/news/tether-approaching-120b-in-u-s-treasuries-confirms-quarterly-operating-profit-over-1b-and-strengthens-global-usdt-demand-in-q1-2025/) (2025-05-01): The issuer disclosed gold and crypto exposure alongside Treasury exposure before the episode. Reserve assets were not exclusively short-term Treasuries.

<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c011"></a>
### 011. Fiserv and Mastercard entering stablecoins create major competition for Circle and Tether.

**Mixed** | Steve Eisman | investment thesis | major

[Source at 9:19-10:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=559s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Incumbent distribution can intensify competition, but Fiserv announced use of Circle and Paxos infrastructure. The immediate arrangement is also a partnership, not simple displacement.

Assessment test: Track partner economics, issuance shares and distribution fees.

- [FIUSD announcement](https://investors.fiserv.com/news-releases/news-release-details/fiserv-launches-new-fiusd-stablecoin-financial-institutions) (2025-06-23): The announced platform would use Paxos and Circle infrastructure, illustrating partnership as well as possible competition. Announcement does not establish future market share.

<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c012"></a>
### 012. Visa is likely to pursue similar stablecoin integration.

**Right** | Steve Eisman | forecast | major

[Source at 9:34-10:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=574s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

Visa expanded stablecoin settlement, consistent with integration. It already had earlier pilots, so this is a continuation forecast rather than discovery of an untouched opportunity.

Assessment test: Track announced and operating settlement products.

- [Visa US stablecoin settlement launch](https://investor.visa.com/news/news-details/2025/Visa-Launches-Stablecoin-Settlement-in-the-United-States-Marking-a-Breakthrough-for-Stablecoin-Integration/) (2025-12-16): Visa expanded USDC settlement and describes earlier stablecoin work. Card networks can integrate the technology; adoption does not by itself eliminate their economic role.

**Unresolved** | Steve Eisman | investment thesis | major

[Source at 10:28-10:54](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=628s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The distribution argument is plausible, but no adoption or profitability threshold is specified. Announced partnerships alone do not resolve the comparative use-case outcome.

<a id="youtube-oRxoxR2mt50-c014"></a>
### 014. Regulatory capture can arise from dependence on industry expertise; stronger post-GFC rules improved bank resilience.

**Mixed** | Steve Eisman | explanation | major

[Source at 12:00-13:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oRxoxR2mt50&t=720s) | Stance: asserted | Horizon: not stated

The stress tests support the resilience claim. They do not establish the strength of capture or the motivations behind each rule.

Assessment test: Separate observable capital outcomes from claims about influence and intent.

- [2025 large-bank stress-test results](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20250627b.htm) (2025-06-27): All 22 tested banks stayed above minimum capital requirements under the severe hypothetical scenario. This supports resilience without proving immunity to every shock.

## Framework and tools

- Separate issuer reserve earnings from payment-network distribution.
- Ask whether a new technology complements incumbents as well as competing with them.
- Distinguish operating progress from market narratives.
- Avoid treating one risk as the only possible risk.

Tools and charts discussed, not a complete visual inspection:

- AI revenue growth
- Cruise guidance and capacity
- Stablecoin reserve composition
- Card acceptance networks
- Bank capital and stress tests

## Source cautions

Steve Eisman presents; speaker attribution follows the full dialogue.
- Index technology weight depends on sector definitions; Amazon, Alphabet and Meta are not all classified in information technology.
